verdict.rationale: Factory's droid exec is explicitly designed for CI/CD pipelines with tiered autonomy, and Droid sessions can produce diffs for review/merge, suggesting a plausible path to auto-diagnosing failed CI and proposing a PR. However, there is no direct documentation of a CI-failure-triggered diagnosis-and-PR workflow specifically, so this capability must be assembled rather than being an out-of-the-box feature.
